response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS daily_price_average FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(r.avg_daily_price - c.daily_price_average) AS avg_daily_price_excess FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN cross_rating_average c WHERE r.avg_daily_price > c.daily_price_average
